title: Pre-flight refuses a macOS stage whose build products or artefact path git does not ignore
body:
The release cut's macOS stage (ST0011/05) and its local gates run at once in one working tree at the release commit. Each reads the tree as clean: app-sign's own checks at the release commit, the gates' changed-path check, and each seal's `commit at close:` line. A path either one leaves that git does not ignore (a product of `macos.build`, or the stage's artefact `path`) fails the other's check, and the failure is blamed on the leg that read it, not the one that wrote it. docs/configuration.md says that both must be ignored by git; nothing checks it.

Wanted: the cut's pre-flight refuses a declared macOS stage whose artefact path, or whose `macos.build` output where it can be known, git does not ignore (`git check-ignore`), naming the path, before anything is stamped.

When: after the release that ships ST0011 (0.1.19), and before the first project adopts the macOS stage. Raised by the hook-in unit's critic review (r1, a note outside the rule library), and ruled an issue rather than unit work by vc on 2026-11-01.

Resolution (cc, 2026-11-05 05:23Z by date -u): fixed at d0a9750f3850da201b3ccf1c17f5a4ffa1101f65, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh from the tested tip da361079, its tree outside intent/ equal to it, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. The cut's pre-flight now refuses, before anything is stamped, a declared macOS stage where macos.app, which is the build: artefact's path by definition, or macos.build_root where it is declared, lies in the tree and git does not ignore it, naming the key, its value and what to add to .gitignore. A path outside the tree is passed over, and one that cannot be read as a path, placed or answered for is refused, naming why. release_macos_unignored (lib/release.macos) judges each path the cut passes in, asking git_readonly's check-ignore of a file inside it, so build/ or *.app/ covers a bundle the build has yet to make. cfg_macos_path_of <value> <root> (lib/config) is now the one reading of a macos path value, cfg_macos_path reads a key through it, and macos's macos_path is its wrapper, its die messages byte for byte. Two releasecut.bats arms: a cut whose app and build root lie where git ignores neither stops at pre-flight naming each, and a table arm over release_macos_unignored. Its run, under hv's localised-test rule of 2026-11-05, in slot 01M6N1K0DDKBPQ4806K76YNS6S on devbin-vc's desk at da361079 on a5eb8dbf: both arms red at the red clone 9deb374d, main's code with the unit's releasecut.bats (the cut arm on its own property, main's cut released with both paths unignored; the table arm on the helper's absence alone); releasecut.bats green at the tip under BSD, 174 ok of 174, and macos.bats, for macos_path's wrapper, 47 ok of 47. The cut's own gates, kovacs leg and CI are the one full test (decision 138).
